name: Dumbbell Waiter Curl
steps: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold one dumbbell vertically by placing both palms flat underneath the top plate, as if holding a tray.
Pin your elbows tightly against your sides and keep your chest lifted.
Curl the dumbbell upward toward your chest while keeping the top plate completely flat and horizontal.
Squeeze your biceps firmly at the top, then lower the weight slowly back toward your thighs without letting your elbows drift.
tips: Do not let the dumbbell tilt forward or backward during the curl.
Keep both palms firmly under the upper end and use a dumbbell with securely fixed ends.
